## Why visit

A small-street beer stop with a useful breadth beyond British cask: German lagers and other craft beers sit alongside a traditional bitter offer. The revived historic name and assortment of objects give it personality, while its position on Hackins Hey makes it an easy part of the Dale Street circuit. It is particularly suitable when the two of you want different styles without sacrificing the pub setting. The connection with Bridewell and Pen Factory helps make a coherent trio of independent stops across the centre.

## Beer

Operator confirms cask, craft beer and German lagers; CAMRA lists Kirkstall Bitter and changing guests.
